claims.statement: Chinese refiners suspended October oil-product exports beyond Hong Kong and Macau, according to four Reuters sources.
The suspension removes a flexible Chinese source of transport fuels from external markets while prioritising domestic availability.
Bundesnetzagentur adopted MiSpeL for market integration of electricity storage and bidirectional charging points, with implementation transition through September 2027.
MiSpeL expands the regulatory access of distributed storage and bidirectional charging to electricity-market flexibility.
Taiwan's cabinet approved NT$180.935 billion for absorbed energy-price differentials and NT$233.834 billion to recapitalise CPC and preserve infrastructure investment capacity.
Taiwan is transferring part of the external energy-price shock onto the public balance sheet to preserve utility and infrastructure capacity.
The Global Forum on Steel Excess Capacity reached consensus on the Milwaukee Framework for joint action.
The Milwaukee Framework increases the institutional capacity for coordinated responses to steel excess capacity without itself changing physical steel tonnage.
Fujairah fuel-oil imports recovered sharply in the third quarter, while inventories and bunkering remained below pre-war levels.
Fujairah shows adaptation around the Hormuz constraint rather than restoration of the pre-war logistics state.
